entities.name: Vicente Bianchi Alarcón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vicente Bianchi Alarcón was a Chilean composer, pianist, conductor, and orchestra and choir director. He received the Premio Nacional de Artes Musicales de Chile in 2016. He is remembered for composing music to accompany the poems of Pablo Neruda, and for his liturgical music, including the Chilean Mass and the Te Deum (1970–2000).

entities.summary: Vicente Bianchi Alarcón was a Chilean composer, pianist, conductor, and orchestra and choir director. He received the Premio Nacional de Artes Musicales de Chile in 2016. He is remembered for composing music to accompany the poems of Pablo Neruda, and for his liturgical music, including the Chilean Mass and the Te Deum (1970–2000).
